The Founders

A Philadelphia militia in Extremis Malis that preys on local settlements and becomes a recipient of Mantis's enhanced weapons before the Division intervenes.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

Philadelphia pressure group

The Founders show how the prequel's arms network works at local scale: an already coercive militia obtains better equipment and gains more leverage over nearby survivors. [1]
